name: singlet_trajectory_terminal_state_identification
title: Terminal and initial state identification
description: Identifies the terminal and initial macrostates of a cell process from a directed transition kernel and writes per-cell terminal memberships. The default gpcca_stability method needs pseudotime_key and calls macrostates with coarse self-transition at least 0.96 terminal; palantir needs a root cell and uses a waypoint chain. Do not use on an undirected kernel, where stable macrostates are clusters rather than endpoints, or as a substitute for fate probabilities.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Terminal-state rule. gpcca_* methods use a pseudotime-directed kernel; palantir uses a root cell.

root.description: Root cell id. Required for palantir; optional orientation for gpcca_* methods.

pseudotime_key.description: obs key of pseudotime that directs the kernel. Required for gpcca_* methods; ignored by palantir.

gpcca.description: Options for gpcca_* methods; ignored for palantir.

n_states.description: Number of macrostates; null uses the eigengap rule. gpcca_top_n requires a value.

stability_threshold.description: Minimum coarse self-transition for a terminal macrostate (gpcca_stability).

n_cells.description: Most likely cells per terminal macrostate.

allow_overlap.description: Allow one cell to belong to more than one terminal state.

threshold_scheme.description: Pseudotime edge filter: hard removes past edges except nearest neighbours; soft down-weights them.

frac_to_keep.description: Share of nearest neighbours always kept under the hard filter.

posterior_draws.description: Dirichlet posterior draws for stability intervals (singlet extension); 0 gives the point estimate.

palantir.description: Options for palantir; ignored for gpcca_* methods.

knn.description: Neighbours for the waypoint Markov chain.

max_iterations.description: Maximum iterations of the pseudotime convergence.

seed.description: Waypoint sampling seed for palantir (Palantir default); unused by gpcca_* methods.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example obs/terminal_state. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, n_macrostates, terminal_states, stability, initial_states, warnings. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
